title: Dropdown configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.DropdownAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

AllowMultipleSelection.description: Lets the user select more than one option.

NoOptionsText.description: Message shown when there are no options.

NoResultsText.description: Message shown when a search matches no option.

OptionsList.description: Options to render: { value, label, image_url_or_class?, description?, group_name? }.

PopupDropboxBreakpoint.description: Viewport width (CSS length) below which the dropbox opens as a popup; set to the screen size on mobile.

Prompt.description: Placeholder shown while nothing is selected.

SanitizeDropdownValues.description: Escapes HTML in option labels and values before they are rendered.

ShowDropboxAsPopup.description: Opens the options list as a centred popup instead of an anchored dropbox (below PopupDropboxBreakpoint).

StartingSelection.description: Options selected when the dropdown is built (same shape as OptionsList).

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
